notes.title: Added Steam Multiplayer (with a few tweaks and fixes)
notes.content:
Writing this post myself this time,

- fixed pvp
- added visual popup for +1 diamonds when merging divines

The new system may cause some issues with the coop, so feel free to report any issues here in discord or add me on steam.

notes.title: Megaloot Update v 1.21
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

We'd like to announce our new Regular Update (1.21), with the new QoL features, game mode changes, balance changes, and bug fixes!


FeaturesEndless Changes
Endless Monolith now appears on Floor 56. Activating it makes the run endless, so you can go beyond Floor 100. The separate Endless mode has been removed.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/7ac520aea89f9ad626a2a2b2a90915a77943dd56.png"]
Sets Changes
Removed Flow. You can combine sets as you want to.

Generic Set now counts toward other active sets (e.g., 2 Demonic items + 1 Generic item = 3 Demonic items).

notes.title: Megaloot Major Update - PvP (1.19)
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!
We’ve prepared a big update that introduces one more game mode - PvP! To celebrate, Megaloot will be on sale from today until May 27th with a 50% discount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440380/Megaloot/

Here’s what’s new in this update:

 Added PvP mode. In this mode, you can choose your team and compete with other players to see who gets farther in the tower. The first one to die loses the match.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/034083b4c57aefca816f535cfb5e30d601caf2b2.png
 At the end of every floor, a merchant will appear instead of a chest. Chests will now appear every 3 floors, in the middle of the floor, and can only be opened with a key . The keys can only be bought from the merchant.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/7f6fe3182a72619b124348feb9d04029d89e5668.png
 Reforged items will no longer appear in the normal market and will appear in the merchant’s shop instead.
 Added a way to make a gift to merchant. An item gifted to the merchant will appear reforged one time the next time you see him.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/c1ed6b692ba7aed780858a796343b3a294d293a6.png

notes.title: Megaloot Major Update 1.17
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Megaloot is on sale for 40% starting today and ending on February 23rd and for that, we'd like to announce our new Major Content update, packed with new features, balance changes, and bug fixes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2440380/Megaloot/

Here’s what’s new in this update:


 Banish Unwanted Loot - After clearing a floor, you’ll receive a few random items that can be banished! Once banished, they won’t appear in the shop again.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/7e1f313f99a2563a0902b50ef037b293a983cf8a.png
 Reforged Items - These items come with random additional stats, set boosters and passives. And the deeper you go, the stronger those stats become. You can spot them by the colorful outline at the bottom of the slot.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/fa3c654a032f403ae4f1abb2c5e16805e960117f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/f68f8c4adf041ada15f22db1ad3904ee2c8e6ecd.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/585ab553da719396610eae580cbd3d4f13d2c82c.png
 Multiple Save Slots – You can now have multiple saves and switch between different adventures at any time.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/8ab78036929df69526f3fed0490f48c4507e62ef.png
 Flow Mechanic and Sets limit removal – Flow is a new system that affects both potions and sets. It is consumed when equipping a new set or using a potion. Now, you can equip as many sets as you want - as long as you have enough Flow. Different sets require different amounts of Flow. Flow spent on the potions refills after each battle.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/f5ddccadb5c46852a7e4495789993a6e12882e70.png
 Stat Limits Introduced – Some stats  now have caps, like Toughness maxing out at 95%, to ensure better balance. You can always check if a stat has a cap by looking at the bottom of its description.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/e5539ad7bfe450bf785a2d7ffcf6ff2673d3ffbf.png
 New Item: Vampiric Helmet – This update wasn’t originally planned as a content update, but I couldn’t resist adding a brand-new helmet to the Vampiric set.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/4667cfbfc3ad760c7f233e37baccd3dadb26bec5.png
 New enemy: Uranus - You’ll encounter him starting from Floor 23.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/0ed9cd8648b6b11e0e55de67fc5c6a59d4e5e946.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/060e6eee2f034913f4ba6684d78bb22d4d93736f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/87e0576afe4459a4bef3de7f5c3caf54120e3224.png
 New potion: Health Potion - Restores 25% Health
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/69febb5a34e471c2c11a894a6063e51c4a62c658.png


UI & UX Changes:


The attack indicator is now located near the attack button. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/cf11b4ec33566668284a86b88202b4f419fe5ce3.png
 Damage and action text has been made smaller to prevent it from covering the enemy’s health.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/e7450de7dfb6ebeabab8ac0d7b414424c1d342f0.png
 You can now see a tip on market items that you've selected in the Build Planner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/ad2769457ca18d9299bf0d9c2ce0495753680d90.png
 Added Brightness and Contrast options in the video settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/2c5d06f6fa7288784e541102d5fca31d1c002127.png
 If there are more than two players in your Co-Op game, each player will now have unique borders on their character image for better distinction
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/1a02ef850036cc56ffa51cd00c353bacfaf62636.png
 You can now view Steam profiles directly from the death messages.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/eaa3eb2df04012868dae5b8d7462eb085a71b736.png


Balance Changes:

Enemy Rebalancing 
Smoother progression with better-scaling enemies.
Dismantle has been removed.
Dismantle was introduced at launch to add more interaction to the shop, but over time, it pushed the game in a direction I really didn’t like. So, I had to make the tough decision to remove it.  Megaloot is supposed to be about loot, not just stats. When players can get everything too easily, the buildcrafting aspect becomes less interesting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/6b3faf5edafedaa383d260f41d9400ebfa6937e6.png

Prelude Event

We are excited to announce a small event where you get to be part of the game design for new items in Megaloot! This event offers a unique opportunity for you to contribute directly to the game and leave your mark in the Megaloot universe.

Event Details:

Players will have the chance to submit their own item designs, which could be added to the game with their name on it. Here’s an example submission:


 Item Name: Titan’s Gold Ring
 Item Stats: +2.5% gold gain, +3 Electricity
 Item Set: Thunder + Golden Set
 Design Suggestion:  Design Image  


A forum channel will be created in this Discord Server to handle all submissions. Players can share their item prompts, complete with names, stats, set associations, and design suggestions (you can draw your own if you’d like).

Vetting Process:
The development team will curate the submissions to ensure the quality and appropriateness of the proposed items. While we look forward to many creative ideas, we understand some suggestions may be a bit too "interesting" for us to legally or practically add to the game.
Once the vetting is complete, the community will vote on their favourite items. The top three submissions will be added to the game, complete with custom names and art

That’s all for today, join our Discord Server where you can follow the game development process from A to Z, aside from that, we also have a Twitter Account where we share various gameplays!

notes.title: The time for the Megaloot Prelude has come!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, over the past two weeks our focus of our attention was focused on the recent Playtest, throughout that period we’ve collected some wonderful statistics and today we will be sharing all that and how it went.

We are happy that most of the feedback from players matches our production and what we visioned Megaloot to be. All the things that were said in our Discord, Steam Discussions, reports, e-mail, and the feedback form will definitely benefit us. Most people have rated our game highly, and we couldn't be happier!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/c3b8c7435843db3039cc187e78e35af38ea537c6.png

Let’s start our blog with some insights on the playtest!

 How many people signed up for the playtest?

We opened the playtest from April 18th — May 2nd, 2024 (two weeks) and managed to get the interest of over 3,000 players worldwide, which is something we never expected.

 How many people actually played the game and for how long?

This is interesting because we had a high percentage of people play the game they signed up for, from the 3,000 people who signed up, 67% of them actually played the game, which totalled to 2,000 players and the median playtime was 1h 40 minutes.

 How many Wishlists has the playtest generated?

We’ve received a little over 5,000 Wishlists that, we believe, were generated from this playtest during the period, a small number with a big impact overtime. 😉

 How much time did people spend playing Megaloot?

We’ve asked this question from the form and it was clear that you guys loved the game so much that 33% of all players spent 5h and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/b56d09aed86f9a7816cc5d333a3bd05e524f196c.png
Soo… What’s next?
I know you guys are excited about a new playtest with a better experience, and for that, we're thrilled to announce the release of the prologue of Megaloot, which we will call Megaloot Prelude, this version of Megaloot will be open, accessible to everyone, and it will be free and has its separate steam page, more on that soon!

The difference between the Demo and the Prelude is that the demo is limited to 3 floors, while the Prologue is quite similar to the Playtest, 15 floors, more items, and characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152478/cfe39728ee5240130adf55a18fc4e05a8a3abcea.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973490/Megaloot_Prelude/

Community Events

Throughout the Prelude and post-release, we intend to launch a series of events and challenges with prizes and cool chances to leave your mark on Megaloot, don’t miss your chance to participate, so stay tuned to our social media channels for updates on that!

Join our Discord Server where you can follow the game development process from A to Z, aside from that, we also have a Twitter Account where we share various gameplays!

Until then, farewell adventurer!
